mutations.name: read-accepts-lossy-text
mutations.what: read() hands out the text of a file that is not UTF-8 (UTF-16 without NUL bytes, Windows-1252) with U+FFFD in it, and a save would overwrite it

mutations.name: read-opens-binary-files
mutations.what: a file with NUL bytes (UTF-16 text) is read as text

mutations.name: save-drops-the-bom
mutations.what: an editor that dropped the BOM character takes the BOM out of the file

mutations.name: save-doubles-the-bom
mutations.what: an editor that kept the BOM character gets a second BOM in the file

mutations.name: save-writes-a-lone-surrogate
mutations.what: a lone surrogate is turned into U+FFFD by Buffer.from without a word

mutations.name: limit-is-250000
mutations.what: the limit of the editor is 250,000 bytes, not 300,000

mutations.name: limit-is-exclusive
mutations.what: a text of exactly 300,000 bytes is refused

mutations.name: limit-counts-characters
mutations.what: the limit counts characters, so 100,001 three-byte characters (300,003 bytes) are written

mutations.name: save-body-stays-64kb
mutations.what: a save is cut at the 64 KB of an ordinary POST, so a text over 64 KB can be opened but not saved

mutations.name: route-hands-out-250000
mutations.what: the route that serves a file stops at 250,000 bytes while save() takes 300,000

mutations.name: save-checkpoint-is-the-bounded-snapshot
mutations.what: the checkpoint before a save is the snapshot of source files again, which holds no .txt

mutations.name: no-recheck-after-the-checkpoint
mutations.what: a change made while the checkpoint was being taken is overwritten

patches.old: if(sha(fresh)!==expectedSha)throw fail('stale_revision','File thay đổi trong lúc tạo checkpoint; chưa ghi dữ liệu.',409);

mutations.name: save-ignores-the-revision
mutations.what: a change made after the file was read is overwritten

patches.old: if(current.sha256!==expectedSha)throw fail('stale_revision','File đã thay đổi; tải lại trước khi lưu.',409);

mutations.name: answer-sha-is-of-the-content-sent
mutations.what: the answer carries the sha of the text the editor sent, not of the bytes written (they differ when the BOM was put back)

mutations.name: unchanged-save-rewrites
mutations.what: saving what is already there takes a checkpoint and rewrites the file

mutations.name: read-says-nothing-of-the-encoding
mutations.what: read() reports every file as UTF-8 with LF
